title: CoreCrates
description: Add customizable crates to your server. Winning effects, percentage chances, and more.
body:
### CORECRATES ![banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/206d67123fec79f105b44d84d34ad698cd1fb391.jpeg) ### ![Minecraft 1.17+](https://img.shields.io/badge/Minecraft-1.17%2B-2C2C2C?style=for-the-badge&logo=minecraft&logoColor=EA7500) ![Downloads](https://img.shields.io/modrinth/dt/corecrates?style=for-the-badge&color=24b464&label=Downloads) ![Latest Version](https://img.shields.io/modrinth/v/corecrates?style=for-the-badge&color=0072ff&label=Version) [![Discord](https://img.shields.io/badge/Discord-Join%20Our%20Community-5865F2?style=for-the-badge&logo=discord&logoColor=white)](https://discord.gg/6qswhdw8nG) ![Fabric & Paper](https://img.shields.io/badge/Available_for-Fabric_%2F_Paper-00AF5C?style=for-the-badge&logo=modrinth&logoColor=white) ### Why CoreCrates? > *CoreCrates offers the easiest way to create crates and highly customizable options. You can make customizations every to each crates..* # > ###

> >

> > - Create a Crate: Use the command ```/crates create "Your Crate's name"```. > > - Then, simply add your rewards into the GUI that opens. > > - Customization: You can easily manage all settings, specific drop chances, rewards, and visual configurations related to your created crates by using the dedicated editor: > ` /crates editor ` > > Visit the [Wiki](https://corecrates.gitbook.io/wiki) for more information! # ### ![Features](https://img.shields.io/badge/%E2%9C%A8-FEATURES%20%26%20MECHANICS-db9a00?style=for-the-badge) ### What does this plugin offer? ## - ✓ **Unique Customization:** Design every single crate to be completely different from the others. - ✓ **Dynamic Drop Rates:** Set precise, independent probabilities for each reward inside the crates. - ✓ **Stunning Visuals:** Choose custom visual actions and unique opening effects for each crate. - ✓ **Flexible Availability:** Create **one-time use** or **limited-duration** crates effortlessly. - ✓ **Special Rewards:** Add specific custom rewards—such as a 1-month VIP rank—directly to your crates! ## ### Standard Case Opening Example ![CrateOpening](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/92dfdfc701a11ebd1f10bc8b517a3d2818117df9.gif) # | Permission | Description | Default | |---------------------|:---------------------:|---------------------:| | corecrates.admin| Access to all CoreCrates commands and features|Op | *All commands require corecrates.admin. Aliases: /cc, /crates* For bugs, suggestions, and other issues, you can reach me on Discord! Copyright © brkstyl. All rights reserved.
